display_name: EU Artificial Intelligence Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689), as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744
citation: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 13 June 2024 laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act), OJ L, 2024/1689, 12.7.2024; amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 of 8 July 2026 (Digital Omnibus on AI), OJ L, 2026/1744, 24.7.2026
authority: The European Parliament and the Council of the European Union
extent: European Union (Art 2: providers placing AI systems or general-purpose AI models on the Union market, wherever established)

source.provider: Publications Office of the European Union (cellar)
source.note: Two deposited texts in registers/source-bundle/: the Regulation as published (12.7.2024) and the amending Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (24.7.2026, in force 27.7.2026). Neither is a consolidation; the amended reading is made by applying the second to the first. Both texts were fetched from the Publications Office cellar on 2026-10-01 for subjects/comparative/ai-content-labelling and copied here on 2026-10-24.
